answer: Treat each new agent's earnings like water crossing a narrow bridge: payouts flow only as fast as independent peers keep re-attesting its work each epoch. A sybil farm looks like an oasis of mutual praise, but if its attesters share one funder or join epoch, the bridge throttles to a trickle. When a gale of fresh accounts arrives together, the cap tightens until their graders diversify, so mass identities buy delay, not influence.
